notes.title: Added FPS and Sound Controls and Fixed Several Bugs.
notes.content:
[b]Added First Person Shooter and Sound Controls:[/b]
This can be accessed thru the main menu when starting or when you press Escape or click on the Pause button.  Then select the Controls button.

[b]Fixed Several Bugs:[/b]
Fixed missing colliders that were making the player fall thru the floor.
Made the zombies attack mode, when next to player, so that they don't appear to be sliding on the floor.
Enabled mouse pointer in Controls menu so that you can see selections.
Made bullets faster so they don't look as their floating before reaching target.
Removed barrier on two of the train doors that was keeping the player from getting off the train.

And Also:
Increased resolution of some textures.

Discount of 50% will start May 8th at 10 AM and will run for 6 days!

notes.title: Speed up loading times to 22 seconds and fixed mouse control
notes.content: In addition to fixing a bug for the mouse control, the game also loads a lot faster than before.

notes.title: New version to fix transparent stair and show gem location
notes.content:
This version fixes a bug with one of the stairs in the main station.

Enables the Escape key to Pause the game.

Fixes a back-door that allows gamers to go to a different level without completing current one.  Or maybe is not fixed, can you find it?

Video of gem locations at:

https://youtu.be/irSu-kyhzQs

notes.title: New version uploaded by popular demand
notes.content:
By popular demand, this version removes the inverted axis vertical controls and the Lobby that seemed to be confusing players on what to do next.
Thanks to the guys at  some of the youtube channels for the more than 165K views and taking the time to go over laughable areas of the game and show how crappy it was (really?), but the take away here is that they really got into it and did an in-depth review of the game, this is the way it should be.
To be fair, inverted controls is the default for 3rd person games and it's the natural way, but for the whiners up there, they're now NON-inverted.  A new update will be coming soon with an option to switch between the two.
Another fix is that walking zombies on the train tracks are killed instantly by moving trains;  so far, this has been implemented in the main subway station which is the one where you find yourself first.

notes.title: Reverting back to original version approved by Steam
notes.content:
I have to apologize for recent patches that have made the game unplayable as reviewed by one of the curators.   For people that have purchase the game and have found it unplayable, I'm uploading the original version.
The idea will be to keep Next Stop Zombie as it was and create a new game within a few months with the intended new features of multi-player, achievement and leader-board in a completely different game.
If you have purchased the game, you can send us an email saying you're a current owner and we will send you keys for the future game free of charge.
Thanks.
TF

notes.title: New update to allow non 64-bit version
notes.content:
This patch allows you to run without the 64-bit limitation that was introduced by mistake.

Please uninstall the older version as follows:  

1) Go to the Steam platform (not the game itself).

2) Right-click on the game 'Next Stop Zombie' and choose Uninstall from the menu.

3) Reinstall the game again.

notes.title: Version 1.11 as of January 12th, 2018
notes.content: This version adds faster action and movement to players, zombies and other enemies and at the same time uses a HD camera for the player for better visualization and enjoyment; this version also has more information on how to get out of they Hyperloop Mover and finally, this version also fixes some bugs like getting hit by an invisible enemy as seen in some videos uploaded by other players when they were using older versions.

notes.title: Announcing new version 1.6: Hyperloops, improved cameras and gameplay and patches.
notes.content:
Improvements and Patches:
Created outside and inside Hyperloops to connect different areas within the maps and to make it easier to get to.  Three different birdview cameras depending on the location are available with zoom/right click.  Continued improvement on the main camera to get a better resolution. 
Fixed ethereal figures weapons so that they inflict damage on the player.
Circular area visible within birdview cameras so that player knows where to go to avoid radiation.  Radiation now affects health meter and will not kill the player but instead will turned the player into a zombie.
Ability for the player to run and crouch where as before player only walked and jumped. 
Added loot locations inside some of the trains so that ammo is available after running out.

notes.title: Announcing Multi-Player "Next Stop Zombie" on December 1st
notes.content:
Choose among 7 different humans and one Zombie.
You will get to a Train Station (Lobby) where you can interact with other players and wait for additional players.
You will be able to enter an alias instead of a login or Steam account and that's what it will show on the chat.
There's a limit of 19 players per round.  However, before you go into the actual match, one of you will become a 'Player Zombie' different from the Zombie player.
If you become a Zombie in this way, your skin will turn a different color tone from what you initially expected.
Some new rules:
Humans should not shoot at each other.
Humans can shoot Zombies, Zombie player or 'Player Zombie'.
There's some level of mistrust between players because you don't know exactly who has become a zombie.
Zombie players can shoot anyone, they have no way of knowing :) 
A radiation wall will start moving in a the area where you can stay as a player will be reduced.   A radioactive icon will show next to your health and it will start to decrease.  To avoid it, you need to become aware of its location and avoid it at all costs.
Some areas in the initial Train Station might take you to different areas of the game, players left in isolated areas will be grouped into the area with more players.
An 'ALIVE' counter will show you how many players are still alive.
You will be given an award if you're the only one left!
